scope: Real localhost browser verification of the existing getResultView snapshotStorage summary for one transient thermal result and one transient acoustic result. The in-page API, the official stdio MCP browser path, and a thermal case save/reload cycle were compared. No product source was changed because no real inconsistency was found.

officialPath.pairing: localhost loopback pairing through the app connection UI; inspect scope only

arithmetic.note: The saved mesh.nodes array contains 513 flattened XYZ coordinate values, representing 171 nodes. The stored scalar-array length is also 171, so the estimate is 171 x 4 x 8 = 5472 bytes. No mesh/field node-count mismatch is established.

thermal.uiStorageText: Stored frames: 4 / scalar estimate 5472 bytes / budget 2097152 bytes. Solve steps and display interpolation are separate; objects, rendering, observations and peak memory are excluded.

acoustic.uiStorageText: Stored frames: 7 / scalar estimate 41496 bytes / budget 65536 bytes. Solve steps and display interpolation are separate; objects, rendering, observations and peak memory are excluded.

saveReload.reloadMethod: browser.reload of the same localhost tab
saveReload.importMethod: window.caseOperations.importArchive with the exported case archive
saveReload.viewMethod: window.caseOperations.view with the imported caseId and case revision
saveReload.note: The imported case received a new browser caseId, while the case revision, result revision, physical revision and snapshotStorage stayed identical. No server-side persistence is claimed.

readOnlyChecks.note: Two getResultView calls (frameLimit 50 and 0) were made between the snapshots. The case import/view step is intentionally a display mutation and is excluded from this read-only check.

legacyAndTamper.legacyTest: legacy results without snapshotInfo keep the previous get/set shape and behaviour
legacyAndTamper.tamperTest: tampered time-history metadata is refused explicitly and snapshotStorage stays detached from the result
legacyAndTamper.scope: These invalid/legacy fixtures were verified by the existing Node unit tests, not by a real browser solve. The valid thermal and acoustic results above were verified in the real browser and official MCP path.

browserActions: window.analysisApi.loadThermalExample(); set transient heat, 20 steps of 0.1 s, 4 requested thermal snapshots and a 2 MiB thermal history budget; run the GUI solve.

window.analysisApi.loadTransientAcousticExample(); keep 4 kHz, 0.004 s, 0.0002 s pulse and mesh size 2; set 7 requested acoustic snapshots and a 0.0625 MiB (65536 byte) history budget; run the GUI solve.
For each kind, read window.resultViewApi.get({frameLimit:50}) and get({frameLimit:0}).
Pair a new localhost MCP session with inspect scope only and call studio_browser_call getResultView with frameLimit 50 and 0.
Save the thermal result as 'viewtime-thermal', export its case archive, reload the tab, import the archive, view the imported case, and re-read resultViewApi.
result: No real inconsistency was found. The existing snapshotStorage summary, its arithmetic, frameLimit 0 behavior, case save/reload compatibility and read-only behavior matched across the in-page API and the official MCP getResultView path for both thermal and acoustic transient results. No source or test change was needed.
unconfirmed: The browser is the OpenCode desktop Electron/Chromium build, not branded Google Chrome.
Only localhost was used; public HTTPS, OS download and cross-origin deployment were not verified.

The thermal case does not reproduce the 94-node / requested 11 / 2400-byte reference fixture. Its saved mesh has 513 flattened XYZ coordinate values, or 171 nodes, and its stored scalar field has 171 values; requested 4, count 4, bytes 5472 and budget 2097152 are the recorded values. The arithmetic 171 x 4 x 8 = 5472 is unchanged.
The acoustic case did reproduce the 741-node / requested 7 / 65536-byte / count 7 / 41496-byte reference tuple exactly.
The save/reload check used a browser case archive in localStorage and a single tab reload, not a server-side or cross-device persistence guarantee. The imported caseId changed.
Legacy and tampered metadata were verified by existing Node unit tests; no invalid saved result was injected into the real browser.
Only one thermal result and one acoustic result were checked. There is no multi-run distribution and no full-suite/post-push CI claim.

The original evidence mislabeled the 513 flattened XYZ coordinate values as 513 display-mesh nodes. Corrected node count is 171, matching the 171 stored scalar values; no separate mesh/field storage boundary or mismatch is inferred.
The VIEWTIME parent remains incomplete; this is a bounded verification unit.

evidenceCorrection.note: The original numerical raw count is retained as displayMeshCoordinateValues. The previous claim of a distinct 513-node mesh with a 171-value field is removed. Browser evidence remains an author-reported bounded Electron/Chromium observation; no additional browser run or cleanup is claimed.
